profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Raytheon
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building C++ software for aerospace and defense systems. My work has focused on applications that process telemetry, coordinate system behavior, manage state, and operate reliably under real-time constraints. I’m most interested in software that turns data from complex systems into useful decisions and actions.

I’ve worked across design, implementation, integration, testing, and debugging on mission-critical programs. I enjoy defining clear component boundaries, reasoning through system behavior, and solving the problems that emerge when software, sensors, and hardware interact.

I’m now directing that experience toward autonomy and robotics. Through a personal ROS 2 project, I’m building a multi-agent simulation with state publishing, coordination, and fault handling. It gives me a practical way to deepen my work in distributed robotic systems while continuing to develop in modern C++ and Python.

I’m interested in autonomy applications, robotic systems, mission software, flight software, and simulation—especially roles involving vehicle behavior, sensor data, planning, coordination, or system-level integration.

Core skills: 

Languages: C++ (11/14/17), Python

Systems & Applications: Real-time systems, multithreaded programming, state machines, telemetry and data processing, hardware/software integration, performance analysis and optimization, system architecture

Robotics & Autonomy: ROS 2; developing experience with Gazebo, MoveIt, TF2, navigation and motion planning, and computer vision (OpenCV, PyTorch)

Development Tools: Linux, Git, Agile development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and refactored C++ software for mission-critical systems, optimizing response times and improving driver communication.

• Engineered a real-time telemetry GUI with C++/ Qt and created a dynamic configuration system to 
   support cross-platform adaptability.

• Conducted full-scope testing to validate performance under varying conditions, contributing to flight- 
   readiness.

• Refined targeting algorithms and coordinate systems, enhancing system precision.

• Built a modular telemetry configuration interface using C++/QT, enabling real time customization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a Python-based log filtering tool that successfully isolated critical fault codes.

• Automated the generation of software configuration files, establishing a standard for error severity levels

• Engineered a high-throughput telemetry processing C++ module, greatly reducing data extraction time.

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
• Collaborated with cross-functional development teams to validate system reliability for real-time 
   safety-critical applications.

• Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) using C++ and shell scripting to 
   automate build, test, and deployment processes for embedded software modules.

• Created Python-based automated test scripts to streamline system configuration and end-to-end 
   software verification

projects.title: Atlas: Robotics Fleet Management Platform
projects.description:
This project features a command-and-control backend for an autonomous robotics fleet, designed for high-throughput telemetry ingestion and real-time operational awareness.

• Architected a distributed robotics platform to process and serve real-time telemetry from a ROS2-enabled autonomous robot.

• Developed a C++ ROS2 node for low-level robot control and telemetry publication, and a high-throughput Python bridge to persist over 10,000 data points per second.

• Built a RESTful API in Python/FastAPI with complex geospatial query endpoints for real-time fleet monitoring and historical path analysis.

• Designed a PostgreSQL/PostGIS schema that improved spatial query performance by over 90% compared to standard indexing.

• Containerized the entire backend stack (ROS Bridge, API, Database) using Docker, creating a portable, one-command deployment environment for the fleet management services.
